## Figure 1 - Example series: survey values vs the published series (Fig1_example_series)

**Files.** `outputs/figures/Fig1_example_series.png` (300 dpi), `outputs/figures/Fig1_example_series.pdf`; plotted values `outputs/figures/Fig1_example_series.csv`.

**Shows.** For two market-item series, 2023-01 to 2026-10: black dots = survey values in the latest release (2026-10-05); grey line = the published estimate c_ in the latest release; coloured markers = clean hold-out cells, placed at the estimate the last imputing release (v_final) published before the survey value arrived, with a thin vertical segment to that survey value.

**Selection rule (applied by code, not by eye).** (a) The market-item series with the most clean hold-out cells; ties broken by more cross-sectional cells, then alphabetically. (b) Among the remaining series, the one with the most cross-sectional hold-out cells; ties broken by more clean cells, then alphabetically.

**Source.** `data/interim/panel_latest.parquet` (line and dots; months >= 2023-01); `data/interim/holdout.parquet`, strata forecast + cross_sectional (coloured markers).

**N.** (a) Jhalokati Sadar, wheat flour: 46 months shown, 41 with a survey value and 5 still imputed in the latest release; 33 clean hold-out cells (9 cross-sectional, 24 forecast), price months 2023-09 to 2026-07. (b) Teknaf Market, palm oil: 46 months shown, 19 with a survey value and 27 still imputed in the latest release; 14 clean hold-out cells (11 cross-sectional, 3 forecast), price months 2024-11 to 2026-05.

**Key numbers.** (a) hold-out MAPE 4.5%, at the 66.9th percentile of the 350 market-item series with clean hold-out cells (median series MAPE 3.7%); 0 of its 33 hold-out estimates equal the later survey value exactly; in 3 of the 41 months with a survey value, the latest published value differs from it by more than 1% (black dot off the grey line). (b) hold-out MAPE 5.7%, at the 84.9th percentile of the 350 market-item series with clean hold-out cells (median series MAPE 3.7%); 0 of its 14 hold-out estimates equal the later survey value exactly; in 6 of the 19 months with a survey value, the latest published value differs from it by more than 1% (black dot off the grey line).

**Caveats.** Illustration only; the selection rule ranks series by the number of hold-out cells, not by error. In months where the latest release has a survey value the grey line mostly coincides with it (c_ equals y in most observed cells, Table A1b), which is why the published series looks validated; the coloured markers are what the release showed before the survey value was available. Where a black dot sits off the grey line, the latest published value differs from the survey value; RTFP's metadata describes outlier adjustment, which we have not verified as the cause (Table A1b).

## Figure 2 - Observed vs imputed local monthly change (Fig2_local_change_scatter)

**Files.** `outputs/figures/Fig2_local_change_scatter.png` (300 dpi), `outputs/figures/Fig2_local_change_scatter.pdf`; plotted values `outputs/figures/Fig2_local_change_scatter.csv`.

**Shows.** Each point is a hold-out change pair (t-1, t) with both months imputed in the same release. x = imputed local change (published log change minus that release's observed-market mean change); y = survey local change in the latest release (log change minus the latest release's observed-market mean); log points = 100 x log change. Coloured lines = Mincer-Zarnowitz fit of y on x (slope beta_MZ, the attenuation factor when imputed changes are used as a regressor); grey line = 45 degrees. Axes are clipped to +/-15 log points (rule: the 99th percentile of all |values|, 10.8, rounded up to a multiple of 5); fits use all points.

**Source.** `data/interim/change_pairs.parquet`, strata forecast + cross_sectional, pair_type both_imputed, local components from `rtfp.metrics.local_components(mode='own_mu')`; n, beta_MZ and r cross-checked against `outputs/tables/T3_local_changes.csv` (CIs are T3's two-way cluster bootstrap).

**N.** 1,411 change pairs (1,411 input pairs; none dropped).

| Rice | Cross-sectional | 75 | 0.15 [-0.47, 0.70] | 0.10 | 1.72 | 2.57 | 0 |
| Wheat flour | Forecast | 287 | -0.93 [-12.47, 0.74] | -0.07 | 0.86 | 11.27 | 4 |
| Wheat flour | Cross-sectional | 117 | 0.53 [-0.28, 1.06] | 0.27 | 2.69 | 5.29 | 2 |
| Palm oil | Forecast | 302 | 0.33 [-0.32, 1.04] | 0.10 | 1.23 | 4.21 | 2 |

Inference: the narrow horizontal spread of points is the variance ratio lambda < 1 of Table 3 made visible; the flat fitted lines are beta_MZ < 1.

## Figure 3 - Revision paths of imputed values before the survey value arrived (Fig3_revision_paths)

**Files.** `outputs/figures/Fig3_revision_paths.png` (300 dpi), `outputs/figures/Fig3_revision_paths.pdf`; plotted values `outputs/figures/Fig3_revision_paths.csv` (the CSV holds the plotted summary).

**Shows.** For clean hold-out cells, every imputed value the cell received in earlier releases, relative to the survey value that arrived later: 100 x log(c_v / y), where y is the latest-release survey value. x = number of releases before the survey value arrived, counted back from the last imputing release (k = 1, the estimate judged in Tables 2-3), over releases that published the cell (releases without the item are skipped). Line = median; band = interquartile range.

**Source.** `data/interim/vintages.parquet` (vintage, mkt_uid, month, item, c, obs) joined to `data/interim/holdout.parquet`, strata forecast + cross_sectional; k = 1 checked to equal v_final for every cell; cells at k = 1 cross-checked against n in `outputs/tables/T2_levels.csv`.

**N.** 5,768 cells, 24,987 cell-release values. A point is drawn only when at least 30 cells contribute.

## Figure 5 - Level validation metrics vs local-change agreement (Fig5_level_vs_local_metrics)

**Files.** `outputs/figures/Fig5_level_vs_local_metrics.png` (300 dpi), `outputs/figures/Fig5_level_vs_local_metrics.pdf`; plotted values `outputs/figures/Fig5_level_vs_local_metrics.csv`.

**Shows.** By item and stratum: (a) correlation of log published vs log survey levels over hold-out cells (the Adewopo-style validation metric); (b) level MAPE with 95% CI; (c) correlation of local monthly changes (own-mu, both-imputed pairs) with 95% CI. Toggle cells (values that appeared in an earlier release, dropped and returned) span many years; clean cells are recent.

**Source.** (a, b) `outputs/tables/T2_levels.csv`, estimate c_final, recomputed from `data/interim/holdout.parquet` and cross-checked (n, corr, MAPE); MAPE CIs from T2 (two-way cluster bootstrap; computed for clean strata only). (c) `outputs/tables/T3_local_changes.csv`, pair_type both_imputed, mode own_mu (computed for clean strata only). SD of log level and spans from `data/interim/holdout.parquet`.

**N.** 16,496 hold-out cells with a confirmed survey value in these three strata; 1,411 change pairs in panel (c).

**Key numbers.** Log-level correlation: toggle 0.97-0.99, clean strata 0.36-0.86. SD of log level: toggle 0.19-0.29, clean 0.06-0.15. MAPE (%): toggle 2.70-3.75, clean 2.88-6.49. In every item the toggle stratum has both the largest SD of log levels and the highest level correlation. 8 of 8 clean item-stratum local-change correlations have a 95% CI that includes zero.

**Caveats.** Toggle cells are not a test of imputation (their survey value was already in an earlier release) and are shown only to show what the level correlation does on a long-span sample. Inference: the level correlation tracks the spread of price levels in the sample (SD column) more than the size of the errors (MAPE column), so a high level correlation can coexist with local monthly changes that the imputation does not track (panel c).

## Figure 6 - Published band vs calibrated 80% intervals (Fig6_interval_coverage)

**Files.** `outputs/figures/Fig6_interval_coverage.png` (300 dpi), `outputs/figures/Fig6_interval_coverage.pdf`; plotted values `outputs/figures/Fig6_interval_coverage.csv`.

**Shows.** Time-blocked test set of clean hold-out cells (cells whose survey value arrived in the last releases). (a) Coverage = share of later survey values inside each interval, with 95% Wilson binomial intervals computed here from coverage and n (they ignore clustering by market and month, so they are too narrow); grey line = nominal 80%. (b) Mean interval width. Labels: ', static' = conformal thresholds set once on the calibration block; '+ ACI' = adaptive conformal inference, thresholds updated after each test release. Filled black = RTFP's published band [l_, h_] at the imputing release (no nominal level is assumed for it) and the released calibrated interval (`unconditional+ACI`: the candidate chosen on the selection block, `unconditional`, recalibrated online as each test release reveals survey values); hollow grey = the other 80% methods in T7. (c) Coverage of the same candidate calibrated once (`unconditional+conformal`) by price month of the test cells.

**Source.** `outputs/tables/T7_uncertainty.csv` (nominal 0.8, subset all, plus the published_band row; candidate from the `selected` column) and `outputs/tables/T7b_coverage_by_month.csv` (nominal 0.8; its month sizes and pooled coverage cross-checked against the `unconditional+conformal` row of T7). Model and split: `analysis/t7_uncertainty.py`.

**N.** 1,129 test cells for the calibrated interval, 1,129 for the published band; panel (c) 7 price months, 2026-02 to 2026-08.

**Key numbers.** Published band coverage 0.59 (mean width 5.0 log points); released calibrated 80% interval 0.81 (width 12.6); same candidate calibrated once 0.70 (width 10.0).

| method | nominal | test cells | coverage [95% Wilson CI] | mean width (log pts) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Published band [l_, h_] | - | 1,129 | 0.59 [0.56, 0.62] | 5.0 |
| Unconditional quantiles + ACI (released) | 80% | 1,129 | 0.81 [0.78, 0.83] | 12.6 |
| Unconditional quantiles, static | 80% | 1,129 | 0.70 [0.67, 0.73] | 10.0 |
| Gaussian | 80% | 1,129 | 0.97 [0.96, 0.98] | 24.4 |
| Group quantiles + ACI | 80% | 1,129 | 0.82 [0.80, 0.84] | 13.3 |
| Quantile GB, static | 80% | 1,129 | 0.82 [0.79, 0.84] | 17.5 |
| Quantile GB + ACI | 80% | 1,129 | 0.81 [0.79, 0.83] | 17.7 |
| Constant width, static | 80% | 1,129 | 0.77 [0.74, 0.79] | 11.6 |
| Group quantiles, static | 80% | 1,129 | 0.73 [0.70, 0.75] | 10.9 |

**By month (panel c):** 2026-02: 0.89 (n 9); 2026-03: 0.73 (n 150); 2026-04: 0.60 (n 149); 2026-05: 0.49 (n 187); 2026-06: 0.73 (n 181); 2026-07: 0.79 (n 262); 2026-08: 0.82 (n 191).

**Caveats.** Per-month coverage is available in T7b only for the once-calibrated candidate, not for the online-recalibrated interval. Pooled coverage hides month-to-month dispersion; months are not independent test sets. The test block is the last part of the release history only; it holds 1,100 forecast and 29 cross-sectional cells (T7 subsets), so coverage for cross-sectional cells is barely tested.
